messages:
Ana K (Sales): Quick ask — Prospect FirmWave wants a tiny assurance pack for their procurement committee before POC signoff: SOC2 exec summary, ISO cert, pen-test attestation letter (signed), and a one-paragraph note on Dedicated price/ETA. Need to respond today.

Ben T (Solutions): I can assemble the pack. My minimal checklist:
- SOC2 exec summary (pdf)
- ISO27001 cert (pdf)
- Pen-test attestation template (we sign after they give TO:)
- Short ops blurb on Dedicated cost + provisioning ETA
- Sanitized staging diagram + presigned upload README

Zoe M (Security): We have a one-page attestation template. We need the customer's legal entity for the "TO:" line and an ACK that they accept our template. We redact IPs/scan details. Turnaround: signed within ~48h after TO: confirmed.

Claire P (Legal): Legal will sign as "Redwood Inference, Inc. — Legal Counsel (on behalf of Security)". I need recipient legal name and the preferred recipient email to include. We'll sign the pdf and provide a signed copy.

Rob L (Infra): Dedicated note: small reserved pool uplift ~ $7k/mo, one-time setup ~$3.5k. Provisioning ETA ~5 business days after PO. If they want customer-managed KMS, add ~$1.2k/mo + one-time $4k integration; ETA ~9-10 business days. Also we need a 3hr external scan window (Thu 09:00-12:00 UTC preferred).

Ben T (Solutions): I'll create a read-only dataroom and upload drafts + README. Will post link here in 20m.

RoomBot: Assurance dataroom created: https://dataroom.redwood/assurance/FIRMWAVE-1717654321 (view-only). Uploaded: soc2-exec-summary.pdf, iso27001-cert.pdf, pen-test-template.docx (unsigned), dedicated-note.txt, presigned-readme.md

Zoe M (Security): Added a short redaction policy doc to the dataroom. Once they provide TO: we can circulate the signed attestation within ~48h.

Claire P (Legal): I'll prepare and sign after they confirm recipient and accept our template.

Ana K (Sales): Thanks all — I'll send the dataroom link to FirmWave, ask for the exact TO: line and whether they want Dedicated+CMK. I'll update when they reply. :pray:
